overall_assessment: All 19 packet entries were read in full, including all displayed plan and extractor text; packet-builder truncation limits comparisons of omitted source passages and is not an extraction defect. The untitled introductions are retained in course_content without visible duplication, and learning-outcome groups remain intact, but assessment/coursework boundaries fail in both directions and random controls expose additional misclassified teaching text, prerequisites and supplemental information. The leak flags identify real boundary errors; empty flags for non-informative placeholders are justified, whereas the short introduction and the reading-list value Selvvalgt are not extraction defects, and legitimate durations, weights, scales and permitted aids are assessment design rather than logistics.

findings.evidence: Arbeidskrav: Refleksjonsnotat om utviklingen av og/eller om pågående FN-operasjoner (2000-2500 ord). Må være godkjent før sensur av prosjektoppgaven.
findings.description: Five offerings (ING3512, MILM1303, both MILM3301 versions and MILM4103) retain ungraded coursework in assessment, confirming their leak->coursework_requirements flags. Required reflection notes, approved submissions, physical tests, presentations and group discussions belong in coursework_requirements. MILM1303 and MILM4103 have a coursework row, but it omits substantive requirements still filed as assessment; MILM3301 and ING3512 have no coursework row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The FHS combined accordion correctly opens assessment, but its inline Arbeidskrav labels are not necessarily HTML subheadings. R/institution_config.R does not enable section_inline_coursework for fhs, so page_sections() in R/extract_sections.R primarily moves explicit gate sentences and misses labelled requirement blocks and their continuations.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable bounded inline-coursework handling for FHS in page_sections(): recognise Arbeidskrav/Arbeidskravene and obligatory-submission lead-ins, move each requirement and its approval-scale continuation into coursework_requirements, and stop at Vurdering/Vurderingsform or another graded assessment component. Preserve final Bestått/ikke bestått assessments as assessments.

findings.evidence:
Obligatorisk arbeidskrav
Gjennomført og bestått minst to coachingssamtaler med samtalelogg.
findings.description: The singular subheading Obligatorisk arbeidskrav, with or without a colon, is explicitly unmapped in these two courses. Consequently the actual presentation requirement in LOG3105 and coaching conversations in the random LED2404 control remain in assessment. LOG3105 moves only the sentence saying approval is required, leaving the nature and duration of the requirement behind. LED2404 has no coursework_requirements row. The pre-pass does not flag this boundary failure.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/blocks.R .exact_section() resolves paragraph subheadings by exact pattern membership. R/section_heading_map.R contains obligatoriske arbeidskrav and arbeidskrav but lacks the singular obligatorisk arbeidskrav; the fallback for an unmapped subheading in sectionize() returns to the assessment parent.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exact obligatorisk arbeidskrav -> coursework_requirements entry to R/section_heading_map.R; trailing-colon normalization already exists. Ensure the requirement block ends at the mapped Vurdering/Vurderingsform subheading, and coalesce the requirement text with any separately extracted approval sentence.

findings.evidence:
Vurderingsform: Skriftlig skoleeksamen
Varighet: 5 timer
Karakterskala: A-F
Andel: 50%
findings.description: ING0321 and ING2306 put the final assessment, grading scale and associated design details into coursework_requirements after a mapped coursework subheading; neither emits assessment. Their leak->assessment flags are real. ING2306 loses both the 50% written exam and the 50% portfolio from the assessment field. OPG3302, which was flagged only for Selvvalgt literature, similarly files final thesis submission and word limits as coursework alongside genuine preparatory requirements, despite emitting a separate assessment row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: sectionize() keeps the coursework subsection open until a recognised subheading or accordion boundary. Ordinary Vurderingsform: ... paragraphs do not necessarily become mapped subheadings. page_sections() moves coursework out of assessment but does not symmetrically extract assessment design from coursework_requirements; the thesis description also inherits its misleading source heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a bounded reverse split for coursework_requirements: Vurderingsform with substantive text starts assessment and takes its duration, grouping, scale, weight and aids until the next requirement/section boundary. For thesis courses, route the final deliverable description and its word limits to assessment while retaining proposal approval and other preparatory gates as coursework.

findings.evidence: Deltakelse på de ulike praksisarenaene er obligatorisk for å få godkjent befalsskole
findings.description: Random controls expose mixed Læringsaktiviteter blocks that the pre-pass does not detect. CBU2502 retains mandatory attendance and practice participation in teaching_methods; ING2506 and ING2505 retain obligatory labs, exercises and online tests there, and the MILM3301 versions retain rules requiring compensation for absence. These requirements belong in coursework_requirements. The same heading-only routing also retains a subject-matter outline in OPS2203 teaching_methods and explicit graded-assessment descriptions in the MILM3301 versions; those passages belong in course_content and assessment respectively.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Læringsaktiviteter heading assigns whole mixed blocks to teaching_methods. R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_coursework() uses restricted heading/gate patterns for this section and detects assessment primarily through Vurderingsform/Vurderingsinnhold labels; it does not fully route embedded mandatory list items, absence rules, topic paragraphs or unlabelled grading statements.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend deterministic paragraph/item routing for FHS Læringsaktiviteter: separate explicitly obligatory attendance, labs, tests and absence-compensation rules into coursework_requirements; move course-parts/topic descriptions to course_content and statements explicitly describing grade-bearing deliverables to assessment. Retain the surrounding teaching activities, without converting every mention of an exercise into a requirement.

findings.evidence: Emnet bygger på ING1502 Matematiske metoder 1, ING1503 Programmering og digitalteknikk, ING1504 Fysikk og ING2501 Matematiske metoder 2.
findings.description: These three random controls state subject-matter prerequisite knowledge in course_content but emit no prerequisites section. ING2506 and ING2505 name four prior courses; ING2317 names Matematikk R1 and Fysikk 1 in the supplemental text. These are prior-knowledge statements, not admissions boilerplate, and their absence from prerequisites is invisible to the heading-leak flags.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The FHS initial block and supplemental accordion both default to course_content. R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_prerequisites() requires a recognised prerequisite label and does not recognise unlabelled Emnet bygger på/bygger videre på realfagskunnskap statements.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .split_inline_prerequisites() with guarded FHS sentence patterns for Emnet bygger på followed by named course codes and Emnet bygger videre på realfagskunnskap fra followed by named school subjects. Move the stated prior-knowledge clause into prerequisites while retaining subsequent course aims in course_content.

findings.evidence:
Spesielle forhold knyttet til vurderingene
Begge vurderingsenheter må bestås for å få bestått i emnet. Kontinuasjonseksamen blir i den vurderingsenhet man eventuelt har strøket i.
findings.description: Both random controls list Spesielle forhold knyttet til vurderingene as an unmapped subheading inside the introduction, so course_content absorbs assessment conditions and exam logistics. ING1501 includes the condition for its adjusting oral exam plus grade-notification, appeal and resit procedures. ING2505 includes the requirement to pass both assessment components plus a resit rule. The substantive introduction is retained, but this separate assessment block is misfiled.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The special-assessment subheading has no exact map entry. Under section_initial = course_content, sectionize() preserves unmapped subheadings and their text in the parent section. Existing cleanup does not remove these FHS appeal/resit statements from course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the exact special-assessment heading to assessment and preserve its substantive assessment-design conditions. Add bounded FHS cleanup for grade-notification timing, appeals and resit procedures so those remain only in the full plan. Confirm the following Læringsutbytte accordion starts normally.

findings.evidence: Emner ved FHS evalueres regelmessig som en del av høgskolens kvalitetssystem. Studentevaluering er en del av dette arbeidet
findings.description: The supplemental accordion is appended once to the preserved introduction, but its blanket course_content mapping is semantically wrong in three offerings. LOG3105 adds the assessed research-proposal deliverable, CBU2502 adds training organisation and supervised practice arrangements, and OPS2203 adds a generic course-evaluation notice. These belong respectively in assessment, teaching_methods, and only the full course_plan. This is contamination rather than introduction loss or duplication.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps Utfyllende informasjon om emnet unconditionally to course_content. The heading is a general container rather than a reliable subject-matter label, so merging its entire block into course_content bypasses the codebook distinctions.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep section_initial = course_content to preserve the introduction, but classify supplemental paragraphs separately: route research-proposal assessment instructions to assessment, Organisering av utdanningen teaching/practice arrangements to teaching_methods, and FHS quality-system evaluation notices to .drop. Retain actual supplemental subject matter in course_content.

findings.description: CBU1506 emits reading_list = Blir publisert and both learning_outcomes and teaching_methods = Må bestås; LOG3105 emits reading_list = TBN. These flagged rows provide no literature, learning outcome or teaching method and should be omitted. In contrast, OPG3302 reading_list = Selvvalgt describes a real choice of literature and is a false-positive empty flag; the unusually short CBU1506 introduction alone is not evidence of truncation.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .placeholder_phrases and row cleanup do not cover these FHS publication placeholders and non-informative completion-only values in outcome/method fields.
findings.suggested_fix: Add whole-row, section-aware placeholder rules for Blir publisert and TBN/TBN. in reading_list and bare Må bestås in learning_outcomes/teaching_methods. Preserve Selvvalgt and genuine pass/fail assessment design; do not drop substantive rows merely because they contain these words.
